title: Correctness of a seeded majority tree
statement: For every seed among $0,1,2$ and every input of three signs in $\{-1,1\}$, choose the tree that queries the two coordinates other than the seed first, and queries the seed if those two signs differ. This tree returns the sign of the sum of the three input signs, with a nonnegative sum assigned the value $1$.
hypotheses_covered: The seed is an element of $\{0,1,2\}$.
